elements.note: Phone footage of the real laptop screen showing the finished website, filmed close and a little tilted, so it is clearly a real result on a real computer, not a mock-up. A hand comes in from the bottom right with a thumbs-up (part of the footage), its thumb at about x 77, y 79.
